title: The tour guide, Marta,...
text: The tour guide, Marta, was very informative and she took ample time to point out interesting points.  We never felt rushed and we never felt like we were missing information.
author: Kathy_F

title: Good tour of the Cathedral and Alcazar
text: Really good tour of the Cathedral and Alcazar. Sergio was good fun and very knowledgeable. Very much enjoyed not being one of the big groups navigating the sights.
author: Robert_B
